about: Selling on the street (scripts/dealing.gd): the first rung, hand to hand. `products`: what a unit is called, what one sells for, what the street counts a sale as (assets/data/standing.json), how keen people are (`want`, a weight), and `legal` for his own tapes. `front`: who hands him a pack on credit (the person at `place` whose conversation file is `talk`), what is in each pack and what he owes for it, due after `days`; the next pack in `order` is offered once the one before has been paid for. `tapes`: who dubs his tapes. `customers`: people this near (metres) who are doing nothing else walk up, one at a time, `every` so many seconds; one waits `patience` seconds to be served; someone who has bought before asks to pay tomorrow that share of the time (`credit`). `never`: who never buys product (anyone but an officer buys a tape). `charges`: carrying more than `intent` units when he is arrested is the heavier charge. `decline`: bought this many units of ready or dope, a neighbour looks it. Words on screen are placeholders; every number is a placeholder, written on 2026-11-15, not the owners'. No real brand, crew or person is named.
